races.paceDynamic: Multiple prominent runners including Poweracclaim, Verhoyen, Asdana, and Polar Bear will ensure a solid pace from the start in this competitive sprint. The presence of several horses with early speed means no single leader will dominate uncontested, creating a searching gallop that should set up the race for closers. With 17 runners over 5f on good-to-soft ground, the pace will be honest but not suicidal, with the main action coming in the final furlong. This pace setup clearly favors hold-up horses like Nouvel Espoir, Sporting Hero, and Verified who can finish strongly once the early pace takes its toll.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the multiple prominent runners create honest early fractions as expected
scenarios.body: The searching pace will stretch the field and exhaust the early leaders, allowing the closers to pick up the pieces. Horses like Nouvel Espoir and Sporting Hero with proven finishing kicks will thrive off this setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tactics Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes more moderate than anticipated with leaders going easier
scenarios.body: The early positioned horses can maintain their advantage to the line, with stamina and class telling. Asdana's proven 5f ability and Poweracclaim's recent form make them the beneficiaries of a tempo that doesn't fully expose them.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Competitive Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If the large field and competitive pace creates a blanket finish with multiple chances
scenarios.body: Several horses will arrive together in a driving finish where small margins decide the outcome. The race becomes about who handles the traffic best and finds racing room when it matters most.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Front Runner
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners gets loose on the lead and steals a march
scenarios.body: A horse like Verhoyen or Arctic Steps could exploit any hesitation from rivals to build an unassailable advantage. The veteran experience of Verhoyen or the improved form of Arctic Steps could catch others napping in the early stages.

races.paceDynamic: Charles Darwin and Kindergarten both show confirmed early speed and will contest the lead from the gates. With only 7 runners over 6f at Navan, this creates a genuine pace duel that should establish an honest gallop throughout. The sustained tempo will stretch the field and test stamina reserves in the final furlong. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and hold-up horses who can finish fastest when the pace-setters tire.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Charles Darwin and Kindergarten engage in a sustained speed battle from the start
scenarios.body: The early leaders will burn each other out over the minimum trip, creating perfect conditions for horses with tactical speed to pick up the pieces. Chicago Call and Frescobaldi can time their challenges perfectly when the pace collapses.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Darwin Dominates Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Charles Darwin can establish a narrow lead without burning excessive energy early
scenarios.body: His superior class rating (OR 110) and Ryan Moore's tactical awareness allow him to control the tempo and kick clear when Kindergarten fades. The Ballydoyle colt proves too strong for the closers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If both front-runners compromise each other but the mid-division fails to capitalize
scenarios.body: Starman Tom and Silk Braid, positioned just behind the leaders, inherit the race when the pace collapses but Chicago Call struggles to make up ground. The prominently-placed fillies have enough left in reserve.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Kindergarten Wire Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the mare can dictate fractions without serious pressure from Charles Darwin
scenarios.body: Her course and distance win last October gives her a tactical edge, and Shane Foley times the acceleration perfectly to hold off late challenges. Home track advantage proves decisive in a tight finish.

races.paceDynamic: Scandinavia and Dallas Star are the confirmed front runners who will contest the early pace over this 1m6f trip at Navan. Both have natural speed and tendency to lead, which should create an honest gallop from the start that will test stamina reserves. The prominent runners Carmers and Emit can track the pace setters, while the hold-up quartet of Sunchart, Layfayette and Leinster will need the leaders to go hard enough to set up their finishing kicks. This race shape strongly favours the prominent racers who can sit just off the pace and pounce when the leaders weaken, as they get the best of both worlds - avoiding the early speed battle while staying close enough to strike.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders go too fast and burn each other out early
scenarios.body: The honest pace will stretch the field and allow Carmers and Emit to strike from their tracking positions in the final two furlongs. Their prominent style perfectly suits this tactical setup as they avoid the speed duel but stay close enough to capitalise.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Charges
scenarios.trigger: If Scandinavia and Dallas Star set a moderate pace that doesn't stretch the field sufficiently
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up horses will have enough left in the tank for their trademark late runs with Layfayette and Leinster sweeping up from the back. The good to yielding ground will help their stamina-laden finishing kicks over this staying trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Scandinavia Dictates Terms
scenarios.trigger: If the Ballydoyle runner uses his class advantage to control the tempo from the front
scenarios.body: His superior ability allows him to set his own fractions and kick clear when it matters, making the others play catch-up. The cheekpieces that sparked his improvement remain in place and Ryan Moore's tactical nous will be crucial.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Dallas Star Spring Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the Brazilian-trained runner gets an uncontested lead and steals a march on his rivals
scenarios.body: His front-running style could catch the classier opposition napping if allowed to dictate at his own pace. The 22-day break since his last run keeps him sharp while others may need the outing after longer layoffs.

races.paceDynamic: Ice Dancer and Emmeleia will contest the early lead, with Ice Dancer showing proven front-running ability and Emmeleia's natural pace ensuring honest fractions from the start. The modest field size means no severe pace pressure, allowing the leaders to dictate reasonable sectionals through the middle stages. Bloom, Chasing Paradise, and Minerva will track in prominent positions, while Thundering On sits deeper as the main hold-up threat. This setup creates a genuine staying test that favours prominent runners and hold-up horses with tactical speed over pure front-runners.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Strike Late
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace stays honest without collapse, allowing closers time to organize
scenarios.body: The moderate gallop sets up perfectly for Thundering On's proven finishing kick, while front-runners face sustained pressure in the final two furlongs. Joseph O'Brien's filly has the class edge and tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tactics Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens genuine sectionals that stretch the field early
scenarios.body: Bloom and Minerva use their prominent styles to stay in touch with leaders before striking, avoiding both pace collapse and being too far back. The steady gallop rewards horses positioned in the first four throughout.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Wire Job
scenarios.trigger: If Ice Dancer or Emmeleia steal crucial lengths when pace softens mid-race
scenarios.body: Either leader exploits a tactical lull to build an unassailable advantage, with the chasing pack leaving their moves too late on the testing ground. The front-runner's early investment pays dividends in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders tie up dramatically, creating a muddling crawl
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace turns this into a sprint finish where any horse can win from any position. Tactical jockeyship and immediate acceleration become more important than sustained staying power.

races.paceDynamic: Spanish Rising, Talk Show Host, Pepper Noir and Casheldale Lass will ensure a strong gallop from the off in this competitive handicap. The large field and multiple front-runners guarantee sustained pace pressure throughout, with the leaders likely to engage early and maintain a searching gallop. This will set up the race perfectly for the hold-up horses to close late, as the pace-setters tire in the final furlong. The strong early gallop and stamina test over 1m2f clearly favours hold-up horses with tactical speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the multiple front-runners engage in pace duels as expected
scenarios.body: The strong gallop will stretch the field and exhaust the early leaders, allowing patient hold-up horses with finishing kicks to sweep past tired rivals. Late closers with proven stamina over this trip will have perfect conditions to unleash their finishing speed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent horse survives
scenarios.trigger: If one prominent runner can sit just off the pace without getting involved in early skirmishes
scenarios.body: A horse tracking the leaders without engaging early could have enough left to hold off late challengers when the front-runners crack. This requires perfect positioning and a horse with both pace and stamina.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-runner steals it
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses unexpectedly or one leader gets an uncontested lead
scenarios.body: A front-runner could surprise by getting loose on the lead and maintaining enough for victory when the kick comes. This would require the other pace-setters to either miss the break or compromise each other.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If several expected front-runners are slowly away or tactical
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where any running style could prevail depending on who has the most natural speed. This scenario would completely change the tactical complexion and favour horses with pure acceleration.

races.paceDynamic: Timeless Charm stands alone as the confirmed front runner and will set a sustainable gallop from flagfall without pressure. Granville Street, Daboya, Radar Ahead, Juniper Sling, Plunkett Street and Trubshaw will track in the prominent positions, creating a reasonable tempo but nothing excessive over this stamina-testing 1m5f trip. The large field of hold-up horses including Loyal Touch, Quiz Test, Earthsong, Kool One, God Of Thunder, Celtic Druid and God The Highness will settle at the back, relying on the long Navan straight to mount their challenges. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can position handily and kick when the pace lifts, as the lone leader may weaken and the hold-up brigade face a traffic nightmare in a 23-runner handicap.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays reasonable and the prominent group can position well
scenarios.body: Timeless Charm sets it up perfectly for the handy horses to pounce in the straight while the hold-up horses get caught in traffic. The likes of Trubshaw and Juniper Sling can use their class to strike from ideal positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses go too hard chasing Timeless Charm and gaps appear late
scenarios.body: The pace becomes strong enough to set it up for a closer who gets a clear run through. One of the better hold-up horses finds daylight when others are stopping.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Timeless Charm gets soft fractions and stays strong
scenarios.body: The leader gets an easy time of it and has enough left to resist the late charges. With no pressure early, the front runner can dictate throughout and prove hard to peg back.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses into a sprint finish scramble
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with interference and hard luck stories throughout the field. An unconsidered outsider who gets the right trip benefits from the chaos.

watchPoints.text: Timeless Charm must be watched closely early - if getting soft fractions uncontested, becomes very dangerous
Watch for traffic problems in the back straight with 23 runners - hold-up horses like Quiz Test and Loyal Touch need racing room
Monitor how Trubshaw travels turning in - has beaten several of these before and positions ideally for this pace scenario
Celtic Druid's stamina must be questioned stepping up from 1m2f all-weather wins to 1m5f turf
Keep an eye on Juniper Sling despite the layoff - well-bred type from strong connections who could be primed
